member.name: T:SimulaSharp.Hosting.SimulatorPackage
member.summary:
Loads a built simulator pack into a collectible so the MMI can load and later reload it without bouncing the host. How it works: the pack's payload is shadow-copied to a temp folder (so the original build can be rebuilt while a copy is loaded), the SimulaSharp.* framework assemblies are shared from the Default context (so /Knob/Plottable/LogEntry have a single type identity across the boundary), and only the pack's own code loads privately.
Accepts a .nupkg (produced by dotnet pack; its lib/<tfm>/ payload is extracted), a build-output directory, or a single .dll. Simulators are discovered by scanning for public, non-abstract subclasses with a parameterless constructor — the generated <Name>Simulator types.
Reload recipe (single-use aligned): dispose the you created, then dispose this (unloads the ALC), then construct a new on the new build. There is no in-place model swap — a fresh instance replaces the old one.
